title: White House registers aliens.gov

tellings.quote:
know if you saw this, but uh the White
House just registered aliens.gov, gov,

plain: The White House has registered the web address aliens.gov, according to Michels, who mentions it in passing to a former director of the NSA, the US signals intelligence agency, without giving a date or source. If true, it would hint that the government is preparing to say something public about aliens.
